steps.content: [Switch Scene]

They say, in Eastia, there was a cursed painting known as the "Jade Fox." Though the fox was rendered with uncanny realism, it was a malevolent artifact that brought misfortune, claiming the lives of many nobles. Only when a wandering Daoist sealed it away did the tragedies finally cease.

The Daoist devoted his days to exorcising spirits deep in the mountains. On the eve of his ascension to immortality, the painted fox suddenly stirred, transforming into a maiden of ethereal beauty. She fell right into his arms, her silk dress rustling as her sweet fragrance enveloped him. In her eyes lingered an unmistakable affection.

The mortal and the spirit locked gazes, their souls entwined in a wordless connection.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 At long last, the Daoist drew a deep breath and held the fox spirit close. Perhaps, in this fleeting joy, his long years of solitude had finally found purpose.

With it, a duet of intertwined spirits unfolded, a delicate dance of shared sweat and soft whispers. Her waist swayed like a willow wavering in the breeze, her scent as intoxicating as dew-kissed petals. The two lovebirds nestled together, their flesh charging as one...
You quickly cover OwO's ears.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey! What are you doing, little clapper? I can't hear anything!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Well, that's... not right, not in THIS WAY. I'll make some changes before we continue.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And we'll have <color=#fb9259>someone else</color> tell you the story.
As you finish speaking, you turn to face <color=#fb9259>Yugu</color> with an irritated glare, peeved about her inappropriate words.
The "wayward" storyteller sits gracefully straight, slowly raising her eyes to meet yours. Her gaze appears distant and wandering, as if her spirit hasn't quite returned from the world of her tale.

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: It's been so long since anyone has interrupted me like that...

steps.speaker: Storyteller
steps.content: Chief, do you find my tale lacking in captivation? Or perhaps, you'd like to take the taleteller's seat yourself?
The Eastian woman gently folds her fan and taps it against the table's edge, the crisp sound breaking the story's spell as if waking one from a dream.

N.F. 115, An Unspecified Day
Between Winter and Spring
MBCC Reception Room

Ever since the Eastian delegation's visit last year, DisCity has been gripped by "Eastia Fever." The populace is fascinated by this distant land that has been long isolated by calamities. Everything Eastian—from its immigrants to its cuisine, from its customs to its exotic tales—has taken the city by storm.
Thus, this Eastian Sinner who claims herself a <color=#fb9259>taleteller</color> has become Eastside's most sought-after guest.

Yugu journeys across distant lands, collecting folk tales, peculiar anecdotes, and ancient myths. She recently arrived in DisCity along the newly established trade routes. Rumor has it that she possesses a mysterious power to weave narratives so compelling that they transport her listeners into the very heart of the story, rendering her taletelling salon tickets perpetually sold out.
While Yugu was at MBCC registering as an Outland Sinner, you took the opportunity to request a small performance from her.
Though no one was prepared for what her performance would reveal.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I invited you here because I heard of your extensive knowledge, especially regarding Eastian customs and culture. This wasn't the kind of story I had in mind...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Fabricated supernatural spirits, and... that... inappropriate content.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Fabricated supernatural spirits... inappropriate content...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Chief, I travel far and wide seeking tales of the most exquisite beauty to share with others. Naturally, they need a touch of embellishment to truly captivate. And in these few days, "The Jade Fox" has become quite the sensation among DisCity's elite.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It has all the eccentric oddities that satiate the exotic fantasies the locals harbor about Eastia, alongside the allure of a beautiful maiden—after all, who doesn't enjoy a touch of sensual romance?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: It is my modest desire to entertain all with this tale, yet it appears I may have unintentionally provoked your ire, Chief...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: My inadequate craftsmanship has clearly dampened your spirits. I shall speak no more. Whatever registration procedures you require, I am at your disposal.
With it, she puts on her veil and assumes a statuesque pose with downcast eyes, upholding her vow of silence. Her display of compliance has left you, the host, in quite an awkward position.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Well, maybe it's just cultural nuances...
When in DisCity, do as we do.

steps.content: The Eastians I know aren't quite so... free-spirited. I apologize if I seem shocked, but I'd appreciate it if you could adjust your storytelling style.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know what your regular audience prefers, but things are different here. Not everyone in DisCity seeks such... liberal entertainment.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your presence here isn't just for entertainment. Paradeisos... I mean, the Bureau is interested in establishing closer relations with Eastia.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We invited you for your extensive experience and engaging narrative style. We'd love for you to share stories about daily life and customs in Eastia. This would help deepen mutual understanding between our peoples, and...
You glance at OwO, who's blinking expectantly beside you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO has been feeling homesick, and she's eager to hear your perspective on stories from Eastia.
As Yugu still offers no response, OwO glances between the two of you, adorning a crafty smile that seems far too shrewd for a child her age.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: You're so bad at reading the room, little clapper! Yugu is just a bit tired and needs a break. Let me take over the storytelling!
With that, she hops off your lap with a thump and bounces over to Yugu, the lion's head swaying as she moves.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Legend has it in my hometown Goldionville, there dwells a big golden lion skilled at dancing.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: The lion is incredibly powerful—one ROAR, and all evil runs away; one RAWR, and good fortune comes to stay! Every spring in Eastia, Goldionville holds a grand fest where they invite the golden lion to descend from the heavens for a dance performance.
As she speaks, she performs a full spin with the lion's head, vividly demonstrating the dance.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: But when I went back to Goldionville, it was already fall. I've never seen the real golden lion or joined the New Year celebrations in Eastia they always talk about.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hmm... How do they really celebrate the New Year over there? What do people do? I'm so curious... Has anyone heard any stories about it before, I wonder...
She bounces over to Yugu with her lion's head bobbing playfully, making the prop blink its eyes with exaggerated flutters.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Hehe, this golden lion is truly a busy one. In Eastia, every household celebrates the New Year, and the legends that come with it are as boundless as the ocean itself.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: For instance... I happen to know of another tale, a legend of a <color=#fb9259>Hazy Fete in a Daze</color>, unfolding in a time when flowers bloom and their scents enchant the breeze.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I've heard about fetes! Will there be lion dances, too? What about yummy food? Are there also lai see and all sorts of Eastians there?
The taleteller shifts her glance between OwO and you, her eyes narrowing ever so slightly.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Certainly. Every essence of life is there—joy and sorrow, warmth and wisdom. This should satisfy what you desire, Chief.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Would my dear listeners care to delve into this tale with me?

A subtle smile seems to grace her face as the taleteller slowly removes her veil. The moment she utters the first words, you feel your consciousness being pulled away by a strange force, drawn into a faraway realm...

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: They say, in times long past, within Phonidale Town of Kingdom Fauxia, there existed this Bloomfete Street where a millennium-old wisteria tree stood. Through the ages, the tree gained mystical powers—those who whispered wishes beneath its blossoms would find their answers in the coming year.
[Screen fades to black, lip animation]

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: And thus, with the blossoming of flowers each year, the denizens of Bloomfete Street would gather around the wisteria tree, erecting altars in reverence and celebrating this godly manifestation, where all participants found their wishes answered.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Word of this marvel spread far and wide, beckoning numerous seekers to the fete. Yet only a precious few—those blessed by fate—could enter and find a single bloom among thousands, bestowed with lifelong happiness.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Now... do you two perceive the scent in the air?

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: Ah yes, the fragrance of flowers. The millennium-old wisteria tree blooms once more, and now begins the celebration.

steps.speaker: Yugu
steps.content: O destined ones, welcome to the Hazy Fete in a Daze.
[Switch Scene]
The scenery before you suddenly shifts in a dreamlike haze, while the taleteller's tender voice still lingers in your ears.
